preconditions.description: The integer n must be within the range [2, 300000], inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(w_odd_even) == n and all(1 <= w <= 10**12 for w in w_odd_even)
preconditions.description: The first line after n contains exactly n integers w_{1,2}, w_{3,4}, ..., w_{2n-1,2n}, each between 1 and 10^12, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i and all(1 <= w <= 10**12 for w in (w_i1, w_i2)) for x_i, y_i, w_i1, w_i2 in edges)
preconditions.description: The next n-1 lines each contain four integers x_i, y_i, w_{i,1}, w_{i,2} where 1 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ n, x_i ≠ y_i, and 1 ≤ w_{i,j} ≤ 10^12, representing two edges: one between odd vertices (2x_i - 1, 2y_i - 1) with weight w_{i,1}, and another between even vertices (2x_i, 2y_i) with weight w_{i,2}.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 600000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= 2 * n and 1 <= v_i <= 2 * n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct integers u_i and v_i, each between 1 and 2n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == q and all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in output)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q integers, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == shortest_path(u, v, graph) for (u, v), answer in zip(queries, output))
postconditions.description: For each query (u_i, v_i), the corresponding output must be the length of the shortest path between u_i and v_i in the graph, where the graph is constructed as described in the task.
